posts.title: Join Club TWiT
posts.description: You can help support what we do at TWiT by joining Club TWiT. You'll get ad-free versions of our shows, access to the Club TWiT Discord, chapter markers, in-app transcripts, and custom programming such as Stacy's Book Club, Mikah's Crafting Corner, Off By One with Jeff Atwood, and the AI Users Group. Join today!

posts.title: FLOSS Weekly: FLOSS Weekly Continues at Hackaday - Hackaday is the new home of FLOSS Weekly
posts.description: FLOSS Weekly continues with Jonathan Bennett at its new home at Hackaday. Host: Jonathan Bennett Visit hackaday.com/floss or search your favorite podcatcher to subscribe.

posts.title: FLOSS Weekly 761: We Won! - The Victories of Free Software and Open Source
posts.description: Doc Searls, Katherine Druckman, Dan Lynch, Simon Phipps, and Leo Laporte gather to celebrate the final victory of free software and open source—and the final FLOSS Weekly as well. Hosts: Doc Searls , Katherine Druckman , Dan Lynch , and Simon Phipps Guest: Leo Laporte Download or subscribe to this show at https://twit.tv/shows/floss-weekly Think your open source project should be on FLOSS Weekly?
